title: Production Parquet temporal and spatial acceptance
runbook_section: LIVE / Repair order and production gates
note: Evidence-only fan-in gate. It performs no repair. A RED finding returns to the owning track and PostgreSQL retirement remains blocked.

shared_writes: This track owns only conductor/tracks/parquet_production_acceptance_20260901/evidence/ and its own documentation.
Authoring tracks provide immutable candidate commits and evidence packets; acceptance never patches their code during a verdict run.
One exact deployed commit and service matrix is used for the final sweep and browser/R2 evidence.
tripwires: Any silent PostgreSQL fallback, future ceiling, unexplained tail, truncation or cross-day carry is RED.
Any request-time historical object listing, data-part scan or bootstrap-census fallback for slider availability is RED.
Any overlapping writer, unowned product, failed lease recovery or fewer than three scheduled advances is RED.
Any geometry seam, support mislabel, simultaneous rung or conservation failure is RED.
Acceptance does not redeploy, restart, mutate variables, repair data or delete storage while gathering evidence.
A green verdict may unblock retirement review; it never performs retirement itself.

slices.task: Freeze the product x terminal-day x zoom x cold/warm acceptance matrix and evidence schema before authoring tracks finish.

Probe private production coverage/day/window/release routes against R2; verify availability pointer/generation/bootstrap-receipt bindings, source inventory root, authoritative required rungs, terminal/source receipts, absence reasons, manifests, bounds, refusal states, no cross-day carry and zero request-time historical LIST/data-part reads.
Run fresh anonymous browser acceptance on latest, historical and governed-empty days at default PNW coarse/middle/detail zooms; record cold/warm catalogue, TTFB and request-to-paint.
Verify exact rung conservation, support geometry and screenshot/canvas-pixel continuity; compare native polygons, event aggregates and continuous fields independently.
Observe at least three scheduled advancements plus retry/restart/lease recovery for every activated product owner and reconcile capability ceilings after each interval.
Run one consolidated lint/typecheck/test sweep on the exact deployed tree, obtain independent review, and publish the service/commit/product/rollback go-no-go matrix.
